commits.message:
fix(host): App copies only the drawing options it names to its console (rich-host-qvji)

A rest spread passed any extra property of the options object — width,
getSize, colorSystem, file — to the console, overriding what the host
decides. One key list is now both the type and what is copied.

fix(host): App takes the console's drawing options as the console declares them (rich-host-qvji)

AppOptions picked asciiOnly and theme from ConsoleOptions by hand, one field
at a time; onStyleError, markup, highlight and highlighter never reached a
frame. It now extends a Pick of ConsoleOptions and forwards by spread.

Review (high): tests no longer pass on a missing segment; WidgetApp's frames
are covered; docs separate the style-name Theme from a widget's palette.

fix(host): App takes a Theme, so its frames resolve the names it adds (rich-host-qvji)

AppOptions had no theme, so the Console App builds always fell back to the
built-in names: a user's theme name drew plain in a RichText and threw from
getStyle under App and WidgetApp.

test(docs): the docs build is the one check that pages name real symbols (rich-docs-kdeh) (#283)

* test(docs): the docs build is the one check that pages name real symbols (rich-docs-kdeh)

symbol-existence.test.ts swept every docs fence for two defects the docs
build already rejects: an import an entry point does not export, and a
member a class does not have. example-runner type-checks every TypeScript
fence, whatever its marker, and fails the build at the page and line.
[LAW:single-enforcer]

Deleted the sweep and code-blocks.ts / resolve-chain.ts, which only it
used, with their fixture suites. The two defect classes are now rows in
example-runner.test.ts's failure table, and the "change the page, not
src/" rule and the three-ways-a-page-lies ceiling live on
ExampleCompiler.check; the compile error's last line points there.

Lost: missing-symbol feedback from `npm test` without a build. The docs
build runs on every PR and before every docs commit, so that was a
second, weaker checkpoint for one invariant.

* review(docs): scope the page-not-library rule to missing symbols; floor the fences the build sees (rich-docs-kdeh)

The error suffix told the author to change the page on every diagnostic,
including a src/ type regression and a Try-it slicer bug; the rule lives in
ExampleCompiler.check's docstring, scoped to symbols the library lacks.
The deleted sweep's fence floor is back in the example-gate sweep: the build
passes a page on which scanFences finds nothing.
